1→# Collaborative Rich Text Editor
     2→
     3→A desktop demo application demonstrating real-time collaborative rich text editing using Automerge CRDTs with Avalonia UI.
     4→
     5→## Features
     6→
     7→- **Rich text formatting**: Bold, italic, underline, and link marks using the Automerge text CRDT
     8→- **Block structure**: Paragraph splitting and joining via Automerge block markers
     9→- **Real-time sync**: Bidirectional sync between local and peer documents on a 500ms timer
    10→- **Formatting toolbar**: Toggle buttons that reflect the active marks at the cursor position
    11→- **Split-pane UI**: Editable local document on the left, read-only peer view on the right
    12→
    13→## Architecture
    14→
    15→```
    16→EditorViewModel
    17→  |
    18→  +-- AutomergeService (local)   -- wraps AutomergeDocument with rich text ops
    19→  |     |
    20→  +-- AutomergeService (peer)    -- forked from local for shared history
    21→  |     |
    22→  +-- SyncService                -- bidirectional sync on 500ms timer
    23→  |     |
    24→  |     +-- AutomergeSyncState (local to peer)
    25→  |     +-- AutomergeSyncState (peer to local)
    26→  |
    27→  +-- FormattingState            -- tracks active marks at cursor position
    28→```
    29→
    30→### Key Components
    31→
    32→- **AutomergeService**: Wraps `AutomergeDocument` with rich text operations (SpliceText, Mark/Unmark for bold/italic/underline/link, SplitBlock/JoinBlock, GetSpans)
    33→- **SyncService**: Runs the Automerge sync protocol between two `AutomergeService` instances on a timer
    34→- **FormattingState**: Reads marks from the document and determines which formatting is active at the cursor
    35→- **EditorViewModel**: Bridges the CRDT layer to Avalonia UI with reactive bindings and formatting commands
    36→
    37→### Peer Forking
    38→
    39→Unlike the plain text editor demo, this app uses `AutomergeDocument.Fork()` to create the peer. This ensures both services share the same text object ID and history, enabling true collaborative sync where marks and text propagate correctly between peers.
    40→
    41→## Running
    42→
    43→```bash
    44→dotnet run --project apps/DemoApp.CollaborativeEditor
    45→```
    46→
    47→## APIs Demonstrated
    48→
    49→| API | Purpose |
    50→|-----|---------|
    51→| `AutomergeDocument.Create()` | Create a new CRDT document |
    52→| `AutomergeDocument.Fork()` | Fork a document for peer sync |
    53→| `PutObject(root, key, Text)` | Create a Text container |
    54→| `SpliceText(id, index, del, ins)` | Insert and delete text |
    55→| `Mark(id, start, end, name, value, expand)` | Apply formatting marks |
    56→| `Unmark(id, name, start, end, expand)` | Remove formatting marks |
    57→| `GetText(id)` | Read current text |
    58→| `GetMarks(id)` | Read active marks |
    59→| `GetSpans(id)` | Read text segmented by marks and blocks |
    60→| `SplitBlock(id, index)` | Insert a block marker |
    61→| `JoinBlock(id, index)` | Remove a block marker |
    62→| `Commit(message)` | Commit pending changes |
    63→| `Save()` / `Load(bytes)` | Full document persistence |
    64→| `CreateSyncState()` | Initialize sync protocol |
    65→| `GenerateSyncMessage(state)` | Produce a sync message |
    66→| `ReceiveSyncMessage(state, msg)` | Apply a sync message |

1→# Collaborative Text Editor Demo
     2→
     3→A desktop application demonstrating real-time collaborative text editing using Automerge CRDTs. Two document instances sync bidirectionally on a timer, showing how concurrent edits merge automatically without conflicts.
     4→
     5→## Running the App
     6→
     7→From the repository root:
     8→
     9→```bash
    10→dotnet build apps/DemoApp.CollaborativeTextEditor
    11→dotnet run --project apps/DemoApp.CollaborativeTextEditor
    12→```
    13→
    14→## What It Demonstrates
    15→
    16→### Automerge APIs Used
    17→
    18→| API | Location | Purpose |
    19→|-----|----------|---------|
    20→| `AutomergeDocument.Create()` | `AutomergeService` | Create a new CRDT document |
    21→| `PutObject(root, key, Text)` | `AutomergeService` | Create a Text CRDT container |
    22→| `SpliceText(id, index, del, ins)` | `AutomergeService` | Insert and delete text at a position |
    23→| `GetText(id)` | `AutomergeService` | Read the current text content |
    24→| `GetCursor(id, index)` | `AutomergeService` | Create a stable cursor that tracks position through edits |
    25→| `GetCursorPosition(id, cursor)` | `AutomergeService` | Resolve a cursor to its current index |
    26→| `Commit(message)` | `AutomergeService` | Commit pending changes as a named change |
    27→| `Save()` / `Load(bytes)` | `AutomergeService` | Full document persistence |
    28→| `CreateSyncState()` | `SyncService` | Initialize sync protocol state for a peer |
    29→| `GenerateSyncMessage(state)` | `SyncService` | Produce a sync message to send to a peer |
    30→| `ReceiveSyncMessage(state, msg)` | `SyncService` | Apply a received sync message from a peer |
    31→
    32→### Architecture
    33→
    34→```
    35→TextEditorViewModel
    36→  |
    37→  +-- AutomergeService (local)   -- wraps AutomergeDocument
    38→  |     |
    39→  +-- AutomergeService (peer)    -- simulated remote peer
    40→  |     |
    41→  +-- SyncService                -- bidirectional sync on 500ms timer
    42→        |
    43→        +-- AutomergeSyncState (local -> peer)
    44→        +-- AutomergeSyncState (peer -> local)
    45→```
    46→
    47→### Key Patterns
    48→
    49→- **Text diffing**: The ViewModel computes a common prefix/suffix between old and new text, then issues a single `SpliceText` call with the minimal edit. This converts standard TextBox input into CRDT operations.
    50→- **Bidirectional sync**: `SyncService` runs the Automerge sync protocol in a loop, exchanging messages between local and peer documents until both converge.
    51→- **UI thread marshalling**: Sync callbacks fire on the timer thread and use `Dispatcher.UIThread.Post()` to update bindings safely.
    52→
    53→## UI Layout
    54→
    55→The window has three sections:
    56→
    57→1. **Toolbar** (top) -- title, "Simulate Peer Edit", "Save", and "Toggle Sync" buttons
    58→2. **Editor panes** (center) -- a resizable split view with the local editable document on the left and the read-only peer view on the right
    59→3. **Status bar** (bottom) -- cursor position, sync status, and peer count
    60→

1→# DemoApp.FigmaClone
     2→
     3→A collaborative canvas editor demo built with Avalonia and Automerge CRDTs. Demonstrates spatial data operations: maps for shape properties, lists for layers, doubles for coordinates, and Fork for undo.
     4→
     5→## What It Shows
     6→
     7→- **Map operations**: Each shape is an Automerge map with typed properties (strings for name/color, doubles for position/size, int64 for z-order)
     8→- **Double values**: Position (x, y) and dimensions (width, height) use Automerge's f64 type for precise coordinate storage
     9→- **List operations**: Layers and their shapes are stored in Automerge lists, supporting ordered insert and remove
    10→- **Nested containers**: The document schema nests shape maps inside layer maps inside a root list
    11→- **Fork for undo**: The Fork API creates a snapshot before each operation, enabling single-step undo
    12→- **Multi-peer sync**: Real-time bidirectional sync using GenerateSyncMessage / ReceiveSyncMessage demonstrates concurrent shape editing
    13→
    14→## Document Schema
    15→
    16→```
    17→root (map)
    18→  └── "layers" (list)
    19→        └── [0..n] (map)
    20→              ├── "name"      (string)
    21→              ├── "visible"   (boolean)
    22→              └── "shapes"    (list)
    23→                    └── [0..m] (map)
    24→                          ├── "name"    (string)
    25→                          ├── "type"    (string)  — "Rectangle" | "Ellipse"
    26→                          ├── "x"       (f64)
    27→                          ├── "y"       (f64)
    28→                          ├── "width"   (f64)
    29→                          ├── "height"  (f64)
    30→                          ├── "color"   (string)  — hex "#RRGGBB"
    31→                          └── "zOrder"  (int64)
    32→```
    33→
    34→## Running
    35→
    36→```bash
    37→dotnet run --project apps/DemoApp.FigmaClone
    38→```
    39→
    40→## Architecture
    41→
    42→```
    43→CanvasViewModel
    44→  ├── AutomergeService (local)
    45→  │     └── AutomergeDocument
    46→  │           └── Layers (List of Maps)
    47→  │                 └── Shapes (List of Maps)
    48→  └── SyncService
    49→        ├── AutomergeService (peer, forked)
    50→        └── Sync states (bidirectional)
    51→```
    52→
    53→- **AutomergeService** wraps `AutomergeDocument` with typed operations for shapes and layers
    54→- **SyncService** manages bidirectional sync between local and peer documents on a 500ms timer
    55→- **CanvasViewModel** exposes observable shape and layer collections, selection state, and commands
    56→- **MainWindow** renders shapes on an Avalonia Canvas with pointer-based drawing, dragging, and selection
    57→
    58→## Key APIs Used
    59→
    60→| API | Purpose |
    61→|-----|---------|
    62→| `PutObject(id, key, Map)` | Create a shape or layer map |
    63→| `PutObject(id, key, List)` | Create a shapes list inside a layer |
    64→| `PutString(id, key, value)` | Set name, type, color |
    65→| `PutDouble(id, key, value)` | Set x, y, width, height coordinates |
    66→| `PutInt64(id, key, value)` | Set z-order |
    67→| `PutBoolean(id, key, value)` | Set layer visibility |
    68→| `ListInsertObject(list, index, Map)` | Add a shape or layer |
    69→| `ListRemove(list, index)` | Remove a shape or layer |
    70→| `GetDouble(id, key)` | Read coordinate values |
    71→| `GetBoolean(id, key)` | Read visibility state |
    72→| `Fork()` | Create undo snapshot with shared history |
    73→| `GenerateSyncMessage(state)` | Produce sync data for peer |
    74→| `ReceiveSyncMessage(state, msg)` | Apply sync data from peer |

1→# DemoApp.TaskBoard
     2→
     3→A Kanban-style task board demo built with Avalonia and Automerge CRDTs. Demonstrates structured CRDT operations: maps for columns and tasks, lists for ordering, and counters for votes.
     4→
     5→## What It Shows
     6→
     7→- **Map operations**: Each column and task is an Automerge map with typed properties (strings, integers, counters)
     8→- **List operations**: Columns and tasks are stored in Automerge lists, supporting ordered insert, remove, and move
     9→- **Counter CRDT**: Vote counts use Automerge's counter type, which merges concurrent increments without conflicts
    10→- **Nested containers**: The document schema nests maps inside lists inside maps, showing how to build rich data structures with CRDTs
    11→

    13→
    14→```
    15→root (map)
    16→  └── "columns" (list)
    17→        └── [0..n] (map)

    19→              ├── "order"  (int64)

    23→                          ├── "description" (string)
    24→                          ├── "status"      (string)
    25→                          └── "votes"       (counter)
    26→```

    44→- **AutomergeService** wraps `AutomergeDocument` with typed CRUD operations for columns and tasks

    14→

    16→var azureGrainStorageTable = azureStorage.AddTables(Consts.GrainStateServiceClient);
    17→
    18→// Add the Orleans resource to the Aspire DistributedApplication
    19→// builder, then configure it with Azure Table Storage for clustering and grain storage.
    20→
    21→// See: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/aspire/frameworks/orleans?tabs=dotnet-cli
    22→var orleansService = builder
    23→  .AddOrleans("orleans-service")
    24→  .WithClustering(azureClusteringTable)
    25→  .WithGrainStorage("RayGrainStorage", azureGrainStorageTable);
    26→
    27→
    28→
    29→// PROJECTS (APPS)
    30→// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    31→
    32→// Add your server project and reference your 'orleans' resource from it.
    33→// It can join the Orleans cluster as a silo.
    34→// This implicitly adds references to the required resources.
    35→// In this case, that is the 'clusteringTable' resource declared earlier.
    36→var silo = builder.AddProject<Projects.Server_Silo>("silo")
    37→  .WithReference(orleansService)
    38→  .WithReplicas(1);
    39→
    40→
    41→// Reference the Orleans resource as a client from the 'frontend'
    42→// project so that it can connect to the Orleans cluster.
    43→var api = builder.AddProject<Projects.Server_Api>("api")
    44→  .WithReference(orleansService.AsClient())
    45→  .WithExternalHttpEndpoints()
    46→  .WithReplicas(1)
    47→  .WaitFor(silo);

    54→  .WithReference(api)

    57→  .WaitFor(silo)

    61→  .WithExplicitStart()

## Comprehensive Exploration Report: Syncing & Networking Infrastructure

Based on my thorough analysis of the codebase, here's a detailed breakdown of the multi-client synchronization infrastructure in RayX.Automerge:

---

### 1. **Core Architecture Overview**

The syncing/networking infrastructure is built in **layers**:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Repo (Document lifecycle + sync coordination)              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  CollectionSynchronizer (Per-document sync orchestration)    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DocSynchronizer (Single document ↔ multiple peers)         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  NetworkSubsystem (Multi-adapter message routing)            │
│  StorageSubsystem (Document persistence + compaction)       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  INetworkAdapter implementations:                            │
│  • InMemoryNetworkAdapter (in-process, tests)              │
│  • SignalRNetworkAdapter (client-side, real network)        │
│  • DocumentsHub (SignalR server, real network)              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  IStorageAdapter implementations:                            │
│  • InMemoryStorageAdapter                                    │
│  • FileSystemStorageAdapter                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. **Repo Class** (`/mnt/d/Work/projects/RayX/RayX.Automerge/libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Repo.cs`)

**Purpose**: Central entry point for document management with lifecycle, persistence, and sync.

**Key Responsibilities**:
- **Document Lifecycle**: `Create<T>()`, `CreateAsync<T>()`, `Find<T>()`, `Delete()`, `Clone<T>()`, `Import<T>()`, `Export()`
- **Handle Caching**: Maintains `_handleCache` (Dictionary<string, IDocHandle>) - all open documents
- **Debounced Saving**: Throttles saves via `_saveDebounceRate` (default ~1000ms) to avoid I/O thrashing
- **Subsystem Coordination**: Wires up StorageSubsystem, NetworkSubsystem, and CollectionSynchronizer
- **Event Publishing**: 
  - `DocumentLoaded` - document ready to use
  - `DocumentDeleted` - document removed
  - `DocumentUnavailable` - network load timeout
  - `PeerConnected` / `PeerDisconnected` - peer lifecycle

**Document Creation Flow**:
1. `Create<T>()` → generates DocumentId via `DocumentId.Generate()`
2. Creates `AutomergeDocument` (low-level CRDT)
3. Wraps in `DocHandle<T>` with state machine (Idle → Loading → Ready)
4. Registers with CollectionSynchronizer (triggers sync with connected peers)

**Document Find Flow**:
1. Checks `_handleCache` first (fast path)
2. Falls back to storage via `StorageSubsystem.LoadDoc()`
3. If not in storage, sends `RequestMessage` via network (async load from peers)
4. Handle transitions: `Idle → Loading → Requesting → Ready`
5. **Timeout**: 10 seconds default - returns null if document unavailable from all peers

**Throttled Save Mechanism**:
- `OnHandleHeadsChanged()` schedules save via `ScheduleSave()`
- Uses `CancellationTokenSource` per document to cancel previous pending saves
- `Task.Delay(_saveDebounceRate)` before actual `PerformSave()` call
- Prevents multiple I/O ops for rapid consecutive edits

---

### 3. **NetworkSubsystem** (`/mnt/d/Work/projects/RayX/RayX.Automerge/libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Network/NetworkSubsystem.cs`)

**Purpose**: Manages multiple network adapters with unified peer/message routing and deduplication.

**Key Responsibilities**:
- **Multi-Adapter Support**: Holds `List<INetworkAdapter> _adapters` (e.g., SignalR + InMemory for testing)
- **Peer Tracking**: `Dictionary<PeerId, INetworkAdapter> _peerToAdapter` - maps each peer to its adapter
- **Message Deduplication**: 
  - `HashSet<string> _seenEphemeralMessages` prevents gossip loops
  - Key: `"{SenderId}:{SessionId}:{Count}"` (ephemeral message identity)
  - Cleans up old entries when set exceeds 1000 entries
- **Metadata Storage**: `Dictionary<string, PeerMetadata> _peerMetadata` - optional peer info

**Events**:
- `PeerCandidate` - new peer discovered (fires when adapter finds peer)
- `PeerDisconnected` - peer gone (fires when adapter disconnects)
- `MessageReceived` - message arrived (with dedup for ephemeral messages)

**Message Routing**:
- `Send(IRepoMessage)` broadcasts to all ready adapters (or specific adapter if targeted)
- Each adapter delivers asynchronously to connected peers

**Thread Safety**: All operations protected by `SemaphoreSlim _lock` (1,1)

---

### 4. **StorageSubsystem** (`/mnt/d/Work/projects/RayX/RayX.Automerge/libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Storage/StorageSubsystem.cs`)

**Purpose**: Efficient document persistence with automatic compaction strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**:
- **Load/Save/Delete Documents**: Full document snapshots + incremental chunks
- **Sync State Persistence**: Per-peer sync state for resuming sync after reconnect
- **Smart Compaction**: Replaces (snapshot + incrementals) with new snapshot when incrementals ≥ snapshot size
- **Chunk Management**: Uses `StorageKey` (hierarchical paths) to organize data

**Storage Strategy**:
1. **First Save**: Full snapshot (compaction triggered automatically)
2. **Subsequent Saves**: Incremental changes only (smaller, faster)
3. **Compaction Trigger**: When `ShouldCompact()` returns true
4. **Compaction Process**:
   - Save new full snapshot from current document state
   - Delete old snapshots + incremental chunks
   - Keep sync states (for peer recovery)

**Load Process**:
- Loads snapshot first (base state)
- Applies incremental chunks in order (replay changes)
- Returns single `AutomergeDocument` with all changes applied

**Sync State Persistence**:
- `LoadSyncState()` / `SaveSyncState()` for per-peer state recovery
- Allows resuming sync without re-exchanging full document history

---

### 5. **CollectionSynchronizer** (`/mnt/d/Work/projects/RayX/RayX.Automerge/libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Synchronizer/CollectionSynchronizer.cs`)

**Purpose**: Orchestrates sync for all documents across all peers with policy enforcement.

**Key Responsibilities**:
- **Document Registration**: `AddDocument(documentId)` creates DocSynchronizer per document
- **Peer Lifecycle**: `OnPeerConnected(peerId)` / `OnPeerDisconnected(peerId)` manages per-peer sync
- **Policy Enforcement**:
  - `SetSharePolicy()` - decide which documents to announce to which peers
  - `SetAccessPolicy()` - decide if peer can receive document
- **Denylist Support**: Never sync documents in denylist
- **Message Routing**: `OnMessageReceived(message)` routes to appropriate DocSynchronizer
- **Events**:
  - `MessageToSend` - forward to NetworkSubsystem
  - `SyncStateChanged` - notify storage to persist sync state
  - `DocumentUnavailable` - no peer has document

**Peer Connection Flow**:
1. Peer connects → `OnPeerConnected(peerId)` 
2. For each registered document, if `ShouldShare(docId, peerId)` → `BeginSync(peerId)`
3. DocSynchronizer sends initial sync message
4. Peer receives message → `OnMessageReceived()` routes to DocSynchronizer
5. DocSynchronizer processes and applies changes

---

### 6. **DocSynchronizer** (Internal) (`/mnt/d/Work/projects/RayX/RayX.Automerge/libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Synchronizer/DocSynchronizer.cs`)

**Purpose**: Manages sync for ONE document across multiple peers.

**Key Responsibilities**:
- **Per-Peer State**: `Dictionary<PeerId, AutomergeSyncState> _syncStates` - Automerge sync protocol state
- **Peer Status Tracking**: `Dictionary<PeerId, PeerDocumentStatus>` - (Unknown/Requested/Ready/Unavailable)
- **Sync Protocol Implementation**:
  1. `GenerateSyncMessage()` from local document
  2. Receive peer's message → `ReceiveSyncMessage()` (merges changes)
  3. Repeat until both sides have same heads

**Message Exchange Pattern**:
```
Local → GenerateSyncMessage(syncState) → Sync(data)
        ← ReceiveSyncMessage(syncState, data)
        → GenerateSyncMessage(syncState) → Sync(data) or null
```

**Active Peers**: `_activePeers` tracks which peers are currently syncing

---

### 7. **Network Adapters**

#### **A. InMemoryNetworkAdapter** (`/mnt/d/Work/projects/RayX/RayX.Automerge/libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Network/InMemoryNetworkAdapter.cs`)

**Purpose**: In-process peer simulation for unit/integration tests.

**Design**:
- Peers are adapter instances connected via `ConnectTo(otherAdapter)`
- Creates bidirectional link: `_connectedAdapters.Add(otherAdapter)` + vice versa
- Messages delivered **synchronously** in same thread
- Always ready: `IsReady = true`

```csharp
var doc1 = AutomergeDocument.Create();

var state1 = doc1.CreateSyncState();
var state2 = doc2.CreateSyncState();

// Exchange messages until converged
for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
{

  var msg2 = doc2.GenerateSyncMessage(state2);  // Nil, or binary
  
  if (msg1 == null && msg2 == null) break;  // Converged
  
  if (msg1 != null) doc2.ReceiveSyncMessage(state2, msg1);
  if (msg2 != null) doc1.ReceiveSyncMessage(state1, msg2);
}
// Now doc1.HydrateJson() == doc2.HydrateJson()
```

**How It Works**:
1. Each side maintains `AutomergeSyncState` (what changes peer knows about)
2. `GenerateSyncMessage()` computes delta from state → binary message
3. `ReceiveSyncMessage()` applies delta → merges changes → updates state
4. Repeat until both sides generate `null` (nothing new to send)

2. `GenerateSyncMessage()` computes delta from state → binary message

4. Repeat until both sides generate `null` (nothing new to send)

I've completed a thorough exploration of the network and storage abstractions in the RayX.Automerge codebase. Here's the comprehensive picture:

### 1. CORE ABSTRACTIONS

#### **INetworkAdapter** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Abstractions/src/Network/Adapter/INetworkAdapter.cs`)

The network adapter is a **transport-agnostic interface** for peer-to-peer message delivery:

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Establish and maintain peer connections
- Serialize/deserialize messages
- Deliver messages reliably to peers
- Notify on peer lifecycle events

**Core Methods:**
```csharp
string AdapterId { get; }                    // Unique adapter instance ID
bool IsReady { get; }                         // Is adapter ready?
Task WhenReady();                             // Wait for readiness
void Connect(PeerId peerId, PeerMetadata?);   // Initiate connection
void Send(IRepoMessage message);              // Send a message
Task Disconnect();                            // Cleanup
```

**Events:**
- `PeerCandidate` - New peer discovered/connected
- `PeerDisconnected` - Peer left
- `MessageReceived` - Message from peer
- `Closed` - Adapter closed

**Thread Safety:** Must be thread-safe; methods and events can come from any thread.

---

#### **IStorageAdapter** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Abstractions/src/Storage/IStorageAdapter.cs`)

The storage adapter is a **persistence interface** for documents and sync state:

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Persist Automerge documents (snapshots + incremental changes)
- Store sync state per peer
- Support hierarchical key organization
- Enable efficient compaction

**Core Methods:**
```csharp
Task<byte[]?> Load(StorageKey key);           // Load single key
Task Save(StorageKey key, byte[] data);       // Save single key
Task Remove(StorageKey key);                  // Remove single key
Task<IReadOnlyList<Chunk>> LoadRange(StorageKey prefix);  // Load by prefix
Task RemoveRange(StorageKey prefix);          // Remove by prefix
Task<IReadOnlyList<ChunkInfo>> GetChunkInfo(StorageKey prefix);  // Metadata only
```

**Storage Key Hierarchy:**
- `["documentId", "snapshot", hash]` - Full document state
- `["documentId", "incremental", hash]` - Incremental changes
- `["documentId", "sync-state", storageId]` - Peer sync metadata
- `["namespace", "key"]` - Generic key-value storage

**Concurrency:** Must support concurrent operations safely.

---

### 2. KEY DATA TYPES

#### **DocumentId** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Abstractions/src/DocumentId.cs`)

- Base58Check-encoded identifier (from 16+ bytes)
- Generated from UUID
- Immutable `readonly record struct`

```csharp
DocumentId.Generate()                    // New random ID
DocumentId.FromBinary(byte[])           // From UUID bytes
DocumentId.Parse("abc...")              // Parse Base58Check
DocumentId.ToBinary()                   // To binary representation
```

#### **PeerId** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Abstractions/src/Network/Id/PeerId.cs`)

- Identifies a peer in the network (format: "peer-{randomStr}")
- Generated via GUID
- Also a `readonly record struct` with implicit string conversion

#### **StorageKey** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Abstractions/src/Storage/StorageKey.cs`)

- Hierarchical key: `IReadOnlyList<string>`
- Factory methods: `DocumentSnapshot()`, `DocumentIncremental()`, `DocumentSyncState()`, `Generic()`
- `StartsWith()` for prefix matching (used for range queries)
- `ToDebugString()` joins with "/" for logging

#### **Chunk & ChunkInfo**

- `Chunk(StorageKey, byte[])` - Data + metadata
- `ChunkInfo(StorageKey, int size)` - Metadata only (for optimization)
- `ChunkType` - Snapshot, Incremental, or SyncState

---

### 3. MESSAGE TYPES

**IRepoMessage Interface** - Base for all repo messages:
```csharp
string MessageType { get; }      // Type discriminator ("sync", "request", etc.)
DocumentId? DocumentId { get; }  // Which document (if applicable)
PeerId? SenderId { get; init; } // Who sent it (set by NetworkSubsystem)
```

**Key Message Types:**

1. **SyncMessage** (`"sync"`)
   - Automerge protocol message
   - Contains serialized sync data
   - Used for incremental convergence

2. **RequestMessage** (`"request"`)
   - Initial document request
   - Contains sync state request data

3. **DocumentSnapshotMessage** (`"doc-snapshot"`)
   - Full document serialization
   - Used for initial sync if available

4. **DocumentUnavailableMessage** (`"doc-unavailable"`)
   - Signals document doesn't exist on peer

5. **RemoteHeadsChangedMessage**
6. **RemoteSubscriptionChangeMessage**
7. **EphemeralMessage**

---

### 4. SUBSYSTEMS

#### **Repo** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Repo.cs`)

The **central orchestrator** managing:
- Document lifecycle (Create, Find, Delete, Clone, Import/Export)
- Handle caching and synchronization
- Throttled saves (debounced)

**Subsystems Wired Together:**
```
Repo
├── StorageSubsystem (optional) → IStorageAdapter
├── NetworkSubsystem → INetworkAdapter[]
└── CollectionSynchronizer → DocSynchronizer[]
```

**Document Lifecycle States:**
- `Idle` → `Loading` → `Requesting` → `Ready` (or `Unavailable`)
- On changes: trigger throttled save and notify synchronizer

**Key API:**
```csharp
Create<T>(initialValue?) → DocHandle<T>    // Create new document
Find<T>(docId, timeout?) → DocHandle<T>?   // Find existing (network fetch if needed)
Delete(docId)                              // Delete from repo
Export(docId) → byte[]?                    // Get binary data
Import<T>(byte[], docId?) → DocHandle<T>   // Restore from binary
```

---

#### **CollectionSynchronizer** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Synchronizer/CollectionSynchronizer.cs`)

Manages synchronization for **all documents**:

**Callbacks from Repo:**
```csharp
Func<string, AutomergeDocument?> GetDocument        // Get doc by ID
Action<string, AutomergeDocument> UpdateDocument    // Update doc after sync
Func<PeerId, PeerMetadata?> GetPeerMetadata        // Peer info
Action<string> RequestDocument                      // Request unknown doc
```

**Core Operations:**
```csharp
AddDocument(documentId)        // Register for sync with all connected peers
RemoveDocument(documentId)     // Unregister
OnPeerConnected(peerId)        // Begin sync for all documents with peer
OnPeerDisconnected(peerId)     // Cleanup peer sync state
OnMessageReceived(message)     // Route to appropriate DocSynchronizer
```

**Policy Support:**
- `SharePolicy` - (docId, peerId) → bool - Can peer see document?
- `AccessPolicy` - (docId, peerId) → bool - Can peer access changes?

**Events:**
- `MessageToSend` - Forward message to network
- `SyncStateChanged` - Save sync state to storage
- `DocumentUnavailable` - No peer has the document

---

#### **DocSynchronizer** (internal per document)

Manages sync with **a single document across multiple peers**:

**Per-Peer State:**
- `AutomergeSyncState` - Automerge sync protocol state
- `PeerDocumentStatus` - Unknown, Requested, Available

**Core Operations:**
```csharp
BeginSync(peerId)      // Start syncing with peer (send initial message)
EndSync(peerId)        // Cleanup after peer disconnects
ReceiveMessage(msg)    // Process incoming sync/request/snapshot message
NotifyDocumentChanged()// Local change, need to send updates
```

**Sync Flow:**
1. BeginSync → GenerateSyncMessage() → Send to peer
2. Peer receives → ReceiveSyncMessage() → UpdateDocument callback
3. Repeat until convergence (both return null)

---

#### **NetworkSubsystem** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Network/NetworkSubsystem.cs`)

Manages **multiple network adapters**:

**Features:**
- Support for concurrent adapters (fallback/redundancy)
- Message routing between adapters and repo
- Ephemeral message deduplication (prevent gossip loops)
- Peer metadata tracking

**Adapter Management:**
```csharp
AddAdapter(INetworkAdapter)    // Register new adapter
Send(IRepoMessage)             // Broadcast to all adapters
```

**Peer Tracking:**
- Maps `PeerId → INetworkAdapter` (which adapter discovered it)
- Stores `PeerMetadata` (custom connection info)

**Events Emitted to Repo:**
- `PeerCandidate` (from adapter) → forwarded to Repo
- `PeerDisconnected` (from adapter) → forwarded to Repo
- `MessageReceived` (from adapter) → forwarded to Repo

---

#### **StorageSubsystem** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Storage/StorageSubsystem.cs`)

Manages document persistence:

**Storage Strategy:**
1. **First save:** Full snapshot
2. **Subsequent saves:** Incremental changes (smaller)
3. **Compaction:** When incremental size ≥ snapshot size → new snapshot + remove old

**Key Methods:**
```csharp
LoadDoc(docId) → AutomergeDocument?    // Load doc (snapshot + incrementals)
SaveDoc(docId, doc)                    // Save full or incremental
LoadRange(docId) → Chunk[]             // Get all chunks for doc
RemoveDoc(docId)                       // Delete all doc chunks
SaveSyncState(docId, peerId, state)    // Persist sync state
```

**Concurrency:** Pending save tracking with `Dictionary<docId, Task>`

---

### 5. IMPLEMENTATIONS

#### **InMemoryNetworkAdapter** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo/src/Network/InMemoryNetworkAdapter.cs`)

For testing. Synchronous message delivery:

```csharp

```

---

For testing. All data in `Dictionary<string, byte[]>`:

#### **SignalRNetworkAdapter** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Network.SignalR.Client/src/SignalRNetworkAdapter.cs`)

Real-time network over ASP.NET Core SignalR:

**Features:**
- Automatic reconnection
- MessagePack serialization + LZ4 compression
- Document-based group subscriptions
- Hub callbacks: `OnReceiveMessage()`, `OnPeerJoined()`, `OnPeerLeft()`


#### **DocumentsHub** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Network.SignalR.Server/src/DocumentsHub.cs`)

SignalR hub server implementation:

**Features:**
- Document groups (one per documentId)
- Echo prevention (sender doesn't receive own message)
- Comprehensive logging


---

#### **FileSystemStorageAdapter** (`libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Storage.FileSystem/src/FileSystemStorageAdapter.cs`)

Persistent disk storage with caching:

**Directory Structure (Sharded):**
```
baseDir/
  ab/              (first 2 chars of docId)
    c123/          (remaining docId chars)
      snapshot/
        hash...    (snapshot file)
```

```csharp
Save(key, data)        // Write to disk → cache
```

### 6. MESSAGE FLOW DIAGRAMS

#### **Peer-to-Peer Sync Flow:**

```
Peer A (Repo)                                Peer B (Repo)
    │                                            │
    ├─ document change                           │
    ├─ trigger ScheduleSave()                    │
    ├─ Repo.OnHandleHeadsChanged()               │
    ├─ synchronizer.NotifyDocumentChanged()      │
    │                                            │
    ├─ CollectionSynchronizer.OnMessageReceived()│
    ├─ DocSynchronizer.BeginSync(peerB)          │
    │                                            │
    ├─ GenerateSyncMessage(syncState)            │
    ├─ MessageToSend event                       │
    ├─ NetworkSubsystem.Send(syncMessage)        │
    ├─ Adapter.Send(message) ─────────────────── > NetworkSubsystem.MessageReceived
    │                                            │
    │                                            ├─ CollectionSynchronizer.OnMessageReceived()
    │                                            ├─ DocSynchronizer.ReceiveMessage(syncMessage)
    │                                            ├─ doc.ReceiveSyncMessage(syncState, msg)
    │                                            ├─ synchronizer.UpdateDocument callback
    │                                            │
    │                                            ├─ GenerateSyncMessage(syncState)
    │                                            ├─ Adapter.Send(reply) ──────────────────── > NetworkSubsystem.MessageReceived
    │
    ├─ ReceiveSyncMessage(syncState, replyMsg)
    ├─ UpdateDocument callback
    │
    └─ [Repeat until both return null = converged]
```

```
    │
    ├─ Handle cached in _handleCache
    ├─ Register with Synchronizer
    │
    ├─ Change made (doc.PutString, etc.)
    ├─ Repo.OnHandleHeadsChanged
    ├─ ScheduleSave (throttled)

    │   ├─ StorageSubsystem.SaveDoc(docId, doc.Save())
    │   │   └─ StorageAdapter.Save([docId, "snapshot", heads], bytes)
    │   │       └─ InMemory/FileSystem/DB saves
    │   │
    │   └─ On next change (if incremental > snapshot size):
    │       ├─ Store incremental: [docId, "incremental", hash]
    │       └─ On compaction: new snapshot, remove old chunks
    │
    └─ Document.Delete
        ├─ StorageSubsystem.RemoveDoc(docId)
        ├─ StorageAdapter.RemoveRange([docId])  ← Removes all chunks for doc
```

```
    │
    ├─ Try StorageSubsystem.LoadDoc(docId)

    │   ├─ Wait for NetworkSubsystem.WhenReady()
```
